text:
NovaGrid Labs is a fast-growing analytics startup helping e-commerce brands optimize pricing and assortment through real-time decisioning. We build data products that combine marketplace signals, customer behavior and supply-chain constraints to drive revenue and margin improvements. We’re looking for a Senior Business Analyst to join our core analytics team and partner closely with product, commercial and engineering.

What you'll do
- Lead end-to-end analytics projects to answer commercial and product questions: define scope, design analyses, validate data, deliver insights and drive action.
- Build and maintain SQL queries and Python notebooks to extract, transform and analyze large datasets.
- Develop dashboards and visualizations to surface KPIs and experiment results using Tableau or Google Analytics.
- Translate business problems into measurable metrics and experiments; work with stakeholders to prioritize analyses.
- Mentor junior analysts, review work, and help establish best practices for reproducible analysis and testing.
- Collaborate with engineering to improve data quality, instrumentation and reporting pipelines.

What we need (mandatory)
- SQL
- Python
- Tableau or Google Analytics
- 8+ years

Bonus points (preferred / good-to-have)
- Microsoft Excel
- Looker
- pandas
- Statistics

Location and work mode
Delhi NCR, on-site 5 days a week. No remote option.
